data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict for the package. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit PKGBUILD due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) should trigger automatic retries or fallback to other models rather than immediately marking a file as inconclusive and escalating the entire package audit.

When a tool error causes a model to fail, the adjudication process should correctly weigh the successful model's complete coverage over the failed model's partial coverage, avoiding unnecessary escalations.
